body.x: CELLUON(president, Cha, rae-myung www.celluon.com)‘s next generation projection keyboard ‘ Magic cube’ is chosen for ‘Product of the Year’ in the field of Mobile in ‘VIP ASIA 2012’ hosted by Global news network AVING.
CELLUON’s ‘Magic cube’ is a projection keyboard product which can be connected with Bluetooth or USB and has hallmark of outstanding portability.

In particular, Magic cube with the weight of 78g is smaller than the ordinary mouse and it can be practically used in business such as document works and memo or social network service like Twitter and Facebook.
Above this It can be used as a wireless keyboard and muti-touch mouse not only in mobile appliance such as iPhone, Galaxy, iPad and Tablet PC but also in Windows PC.

CELLUON president, Cha rae-myung said “Magic key is more demanding in overseas than domestic market as needs of Tablet PC input device increases consistently in abroad” and , “ we are planning to show innovative products in CES 2013 host in Las Vegas. We will also launch Korean version and expand market as well.”

Meanwhile, AVING news is building a global media network with portal site, news, blog and 778 medium of 54 countries, and holding VIP ASIA AWARDS which choose the outstanding products that received attention from buyer and news editors in market every year.

Furthermore, “Main promotion” field was also rewarded this year. KIMES, KOBA, LED EXPO & OLED EXPO, EDUCARE, PHOTO&IMAGING were chosen for Global Premium Exhibition field in ‘Very Important Promotion’ award.
